problem: Netlify production could not advance from the old commit because the deterministic English localization build failed closed with 1,926 untranslated post-build strings.
root_cause: The production build mutates and generates public HTML before static English localization runs.
The immutable English cache covered the earlier source set but not all strings present after the full production build composition.
STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1 correctly blocked deployment instead of publishing partially translated English pages.
prevention: Run the exact pre-i18n production composition before validating static English cache completeness.
Require build-localized-routes.mjs --validate-cache against the post-composition public route set before production promotion.
Keep production STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=0 and STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1 so Netlify never depends on an online translation provider.
Generate missing cache entries in an authorized CI recovery lane, commit the resulting immutable cache, then prove offline completeness.
Never mark production live from a green non-deployment readback when release.json commit_ref differs from protected main.
